correctness.rationale: For m≥3 and s≥2, two omitted leaves at the same spoke can never be forced, so s−1 leaves per bundle are mandatory. With just those leaves, the process stops after the spokes turn blue. At the next cardinality there is one extra vertex: a spoke still leaves the hub and one leaf at each spoke white, whereas the hub and an extra leaf give exactly the two claimed classes. In the hub class, round 1 colors the spokes and round 2 the omissions. In the saturated class, no spoke is initially blue; round 1 colors all spokes, only the saturated spoke can force in round 2 (it forces the hub), and round 3 colors the remaining leaves. There are s^m and m s^(m−1) sets, respectively, by independent choices of omissions. This also proves the efficient-set statement.
residual_risks: Replay tests the necessary leaf patterns and counts finite saturated families; it is not an exhaustive arbitrary-order computation. The frozen checker considers the minimum layer on ten profiles, and the immediately smaller layer only when its binomial size is at most 100,000.
